	<AsamApplicationProvider :config="{ colorMode: dark ? 'dark' : 'light', size }"
		><main>
			<Teleport to="#preview-settings-extra" :disabled="!websitePreviewControls"
				><WebsiteAsamConfigProvider size="default"
					><section class="preview-control-group">
						<details class="fixture-options">
							<summary>本地合成服务演示设置</summary>
							<!-- prettier-ignore --><label>尺寸<AsamSelect :model-value="size" @update:model-value="selectSize($event)" aria-label="尺寸"><AsamOption value="small" label="small">small</AsamOption><AsamOption value="default" label="default">default</AsamOption><AsamOption value="big" label="big">big</AsamOption><AsamOption value="large" label="large">large</AsamOption></AsamSelect></label
							><!-- prettier-ignore --><label v-show="!websitePreviewControls"><span v-show="!websitePreviewControls" data-preview-theme-control :data-preview-value="dark" v-on="{ 'asam-preview-theme': websitePreviewTheme0 }"><AsamCheckboxItem :model-value="dark" @update:model-value="updateFlag('dark', $event)"  border /></span>深色</label
							><!-- prettier-ignore --><AsamCheckboxItem :model-value="readonly" @update:model-value="updateFlag('readonly', $event)"  border>只读</AsamCheckboxItem
							><!-- prettier-ignore --><AsamCheckboxItem :model-value="disabled" @update:model-value="updateFlag('disabled', $event)"  border>禁用</AsamCheckboxItem
							><!-- prettier-ignore --><AsamCheckboxItem :model-value="active" @update:model-value="updateFlag('active', $event)"  border>活动</AsamCheckboxItem
							><!-- prettier-ignore --><AsamCheckboxItem :model-value="resourceAvailable" @update:model-value="updateFlag('resourceAvailable', $event)"  border>资源服务可用</AsamCheckboxItem
							><!-- prettier-ignore --><AsamCheckboxItem :model-value="controls.allowDiscard" @update:model-value="updateFlag('allowDiscard', $event)"  border>宿主明确允许丢弃</AsamCheckboxItem
							><!-- prettier-ignore --><AsamCheckboxItem :model-value="controls.loadFail" @update:model-value="updateFlag('loadFail', $event)"  border>加载失败</AsamCheckboxItem
							><!-- prettier-ignore --><AsamCheckboxItem :model-value="controls.uploadFail" @update:model-value="updateFlag('uploadFail', $event)"  border>资源失败</AsamCheckboxItem
							><!-- prettier-ignore --><AsamCheckboxItem :model-value="controls.uploadLate" @update:model-value="updateFlag('uploadLate', $event)"  border>资源忽略取消</AsamCheckboxItem
							><!-- prettier-ignore -->
							<div class="preview-choice-field"><span>保存行为</span><WebsiteAsamRadioGroup :model-value="controls.mode" @update:model-value="selectMode($event)" aria-label="保存行为" class="preview-choice-grid"><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="success" border>success</WebsiteAsamRadioItem><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="not-written" border>not-written</WebsiteAsamRadioItem><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="unknown" border>unknown</WebsiteAsamRadioItem><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="throw" border>throw</WebsiteAsamRadioItem><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="late" border>late</WebsiteAsamRadioItem></WebsiteAsamRadioGroup></div>
							<AsamButton

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) {
	updateFlag('dark', event.detail === 'dark');
}
function websiteNativeEvent(value: unknown, type: string) {
	const event = new Event(type);
	Object.defineProperty(event, 'target', { value: { value, checked: value } });
	return event;
}

import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, reactive, ref, shallowRef, toRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { RichTextEditorPage, MarkdownEditorPage } from '../../../templates/editors/Index.js';
import type {
	EditorPageDocument,
	EditorPageExpose,
	EditorPageId,
	EditorPageKind,
	EditorPageTarget
} from '../../../templates/editors/Types.js';
import { createFixtureHost } from './FixtureHost.js';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const kind = params.get('kind') === 'markdown' ? 'markdown' : 'richtext';
const dual = params.has('dual');
const dark = ref(params.get('theme') === 'dark');
const size = ref<AsamControlSize>((params.get('size') as AsamControlSize) || 'default');
const readonly = ref(params.has('readonly'));
const disabled = ref(false);
const active = ref(true);
const resourceAvailable = ref(true);
const maxLength = ref(30000);
const fixture = createFixtureHost(new URL('./fixture.svg', import.meta.url).href, true);
const documentId = ref<EditorPageId>(fixture.initialDocumentId);
const controls = reactive(fixture.controls);
const flags = {
	dark,
	readonly,
	disabled,
	active,
	resourceAvailable,
	allowDiscard: toRef(controls, 'allowDiscard'),
	loadFail: toRef(controls, 'loadFail'),
	uploadFail: toRef(controls, 'uploadFail'),
	uploadLate: toRef(controls, 'uploadLate')
};
function updateFlag(key: keyof typeof flags, value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'boolean') flags[key].value = value;
}
function selectSize(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'small' || value === 'default' || value === 'big' || value === 'large')
		size.value = value;
}
function selectMode(value: unknown) {
	if (
		value === 'success' ||
		value === 'not-written' ||
		value === 'unknown' ||
		value === 'throw' ||
		value === 'late'
	)
		controls.mode = value;
}
const rich = shallowRef<EditorPageExpose>();
const markdown = shallowRef<EditorPageExpose>();
const savedRevisions = reactive(new Map<string, EditorPageId>());
function documentKey(target: Omit<EditorPageTarget, 'revision'>) {
	return JSON.stringify([
		target.identity,
		target.scope,
		typeof target.documentId,
		target.documentId,
		target.kind
	]);
}
function rememberSaved(document: EditorPageDocument) {
	// 只回显版本；保存期间产生的后续草稿仍由页面持有。
	savedRevisions.set(documentKey(document), document.revision);
}
function revisionFor(kind: EditorPageKind) {
	return (
		savedRevisions.get(
			documentKey({
				identity: 'fixture-user',
				scope: 'local-documents',
				documentId: documentId.value,
				kind
			})
		) ?? (documentId.value === fixture.initialDocumentId ? fixture.initialRevision : 0)
	);
}
const richTarget = computed<EditorPageTarget & { kind: 'richtext' }>(() => ({
	identity: 'fixture-user',
	scope: 'local-documents',
	documentId: documentId.value,
	revision: revisionFor('richtext'),
	kind: 'richtext'
}));
const markdownTarget = computed<EditorPageTarget & { kind: 'markdown' }>(() => ({
	identity: 'fixture-user',
	scope: 'local-documents',
	documentId: documentId.value,
	revision: revisionFor('markdown'),
	kind: 'markdown'
}));
// 测试夹具仅通过公开 ref 操作，不读编辑器内部对象。
const bridge = {
	fixture,
	rich,
	markdown,
	controls,
	dark,
	size,
	readonly,
	disabled,
	active,
	documentId,
	resourceAvailable,
	maxLength
};
Object.assign(window, { editorPagesFixture: bridge });
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	Reflect.deleteProperty(window, 'editorPagesFixture');
});
</script>

<style scoped>
main {
	min-height: 100%;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
}
.fixture-options {
	max-width: 76rem;
	margin: auto;
	padding: var(--asam-space-sm);
}
.fixture-options label {
	display: inline-flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-xs);
	margin-inline-end: var(--asam-space-sm);
}
</style>
ts
import { templateText } from './i18n/index.js';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { formatFieldError, createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type { TemplateMessageKey } from './i18n/index.js';
import { cloneAsamEditorValue, editorValueLength } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	EditorPageDocument,
	EditorPageHost,
	EditorPageProps,
	EditorPageState,
	EditorPageTarget,
	EditorPageValue,
	EditorPageWrite,
	EditorPageWriteResult
} from './Types.js';

const idleResources = () => ({
	pending: false,
	progress: 0,
	error: '',
	status: 'idle' as const,
	generation: 0
});
const validId = (id: unknown) =>
	(typeof id === 'number' && Number.isFinite(id)) ||
	(typeof id === 'string' && id.trim().length > 0);
export function assertEditorPageTarget(target: EditorPageTarget): void {
	if (
		!target ||
		typeof target.identity !== 'string' ||
		!target.identity.trim() ||
		typeof target.scope !== 'string' ||
		!target.scope.trim() ||
		!validId(target.documentId) ||
		!validId(target.revision) ||
		!['richtext', 'markdown'].includes(target.kind)
	)
		throw new TypeError('文档身份、范围、ID、格式或版本无效');
}
export const sameEditorPageTarget = (a: EditorPageTarget, b: EditorPageTarget): boolean =>
	a.identity === b.identity &&
	a.scope === b.scope &&
	a.documentId === b.documentId &&
	a.kind === b.kind &&
	a.revision === b.revision;
const targetCopy = (target: EditorPageTarget): EditorPageTarget => ({
	identity: target.identity,
	scope: target.scope,
	documentId: target.documentId,
	kind: target.kind,
	revision: target.revision
});
function documentCopy(target: EditorPageTarget, value: unknown): EditorPageDocument {
	const copy = cloneAsamEditorValue(target.kind, value);
	return target.kind === 'markdown'
		? { ...targetCopy(target), kind: 'markdown', value: copy as string }
		: {
				...targetCopy(target),
				kind: 'richtext',
				value: copy as Exclude<EditorPageValue, string>
			};
}
function assertPageProps(props: EditorPageProps): void {
	assertEditorPageTarget(props.target);
	if (
		!props.host ||
		typeof props.host.load !== 'function' ||
		typeof props.host.save !== 'function'
	)
		throw new TypeError('页面必须显式提供 load/save host');
	if (
		props.maxLength !== undefined &&
		(!Number.isInteger(props.maxLength) || props.maxLength < 0)
	)
		throw new TypeError('maxLength 必须为非负整数');
}

/** 仅编排本页文档操作，编辑与资源生命周期始终由公开 014 字段承担。 */
export class EditorPageController {
	private props: EditorPageProps;
	private acceptedProps: EditorPageProps;
	private state: EditorPageState;
	private baseline = '';
	private epoch = 0;
	private configuration = 0;
	private dead = false;
	private operation?: AbortController;
	private unknown?: { request: EditorPageDocument; operationId: string; host: EditorPageHost };
	private readonly instanceId = Array.from(
		globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(4)),
		(part) => part.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
	).join('-');
	private sequence = 0;
	constructor(
		props: EditorPageProps,
		private readonly notify: (state: EditorPageState) => void,
		private readonly saved: (document: EditorPageDocument) => void,
		private readonly cancelResources: () => void
	) {
		assertPageProps(props);
		this.props = { ...props, target: targetCopy(props.target) };
		this.acceptedProps = this.props;
		this.state = {
			target: targetCopy(props.target),
			value: cloneAsamEditorValue(props.target.kind, undefined),
			ready: false,
			dirty: false,
			pending: null,
			outcome: 'idle',
			error: '',
			blocked: false,
			resources: idleResources()
		};
	}
	getState(): EditorPageState {
		return {
			...this.state,
			target: targetCopy(this.state.target),
			value: cloneAsamEditorValue(this.state.target.kind, this.state.value),
			resources: { ...this.state.resources }
		};
	}
	private errorSource?: { key: TemplateMessageKey; cause?: unknown };

	formatMessage(scope: AsamI18n) {
		if (!scope.enabled.value || !this.errorSource) return this.state.error;
		const message = templateText(scope, this.errorSource.key);
		const cause = this.errorSource.cause;
		if (!(cause instanceof Error)) return message;
		return scope.t('app.templates.editors.errorWithCause', {
			message,
			cause: formatFieldError(cause, scope)
		});
	}
	private publish(
		patch: Partial<EditorPageState> = {},
		source?: { key: TemplateMessageKey; cause?: unknown }
	) {
		if (Object.hasOwn(patch, 'error')) this.errorSource = source;
		this.state = { ...this.state, ...patch };
		if (!this.dead) this.notify(this.getState());
	}
	private writable() {
		return (
			!this.dead &&
			this.props.active !== false &&
			!this.props.disabled &&
			!this.props.readonly
		);
	}
	private rememberUnknown() {
		if (!this.unknown) return;
		this.publish(
			{
				outcome: 'unknown',
				unknownOperationId: this.unknown.operationId,
				error: '保存结果尚未核实；内容保留，请核实原操作，勿重复提交'
			},
			{ key: 'app.templates.editors.theSaveResultIsUnverifiedContentIsRetainedVerify' }
		);
	}
	private invalidate() {
		this.epoch++;
		this.operation?.abort();
		this.operation = undefined;
		this.cancelResources();
		this.publish({ pending: null });
		this.rememberUnknown();
	}
	private begin(pending: NonNullable<EditorPageState['pending']>) {
		const controller = new AbortController();
		this.operation = controller;
		const token = ++this.epoch;
		this.publish({ pending, error: '' });
		return {
			controller,
			current: () => !this.dead && token === this.epoch && !controller.signal.aborted
		};
	}
	async configure(props: EditorPageProps): Promise<void> {
		assertPageProps(props);
		const changed =
			!sameEditorPageTarget(props.target, this.props.target) ||
			props.host !== this.props.host ||
			props.resources !== this.props.resources;
		const lockedChanged =
			props.active !== this.props.active ||
			props.readonly !== this.props.readonly ||
			props.disabled !== this.props.disabled;
		if (changed || lockedChanged) this.configuration++;
		const configuration = this.configuration;
		// 宿主接收 saved 后回显新版本，不能丢弃保存期间产生的新编辑。
		if (
			changed &&
			this.state.ready &&
			!this.state.blocked &&
			sameEditorPageTarget(props.target, this.state.target) &&
			props.host === this.acceptedProps.host &&
			props.resources === this.acceptedProps.resources
		) {
			this.props = { ...props, target: targetCopy(props.target) };
			this.acceptedProps = this.props;
			if (lockedChanged) {
				this.invalidate();
				this.publish({ resources: idleResources() });
			}
			return;
		}
		if (!changed) {
			this.props = { ...props, target: targetCopy(props.target) };
			if (lockedChanged) {
				this.invalidate();
				this.publish({ resources: idleResources() });
			}
			this.publish();
			if (props.active !== false && !this.state.ready && !this.state.pending)
				await this.load();
			return;
		}
		const oldHost = this.acceptedProps.host;
		this.invalidate();
		this.publish({ resources: idleResources() });
		this.props = { ...props, target: targetCopy(props.target) };
		if (
			this.state.blocked &&
			sameEditorPageTarget(props.target, this.acceptedProps.target) &&
			props.host === this.acceptedProps.host &&
			props.resources === this.acceptedProps.resources
		) {
			this.publish({ blocked: false, error: '' });
			this.rememberUnknown();
			return;
		}
		this.publish({ blocked: true });
		if (
			!(await this.confirm('switch', oldHost, props.target)) ||
			configuration !== this.configuration ||
			this.dead
		)
			return;
		this.acceptedProps = this.props;
		this.unknown = undefined;
		this.baseline = '';
		this.publish({
			target: targetCopy(props.target),
			value: cloneAsamEditorValue(props.target.kind, undefined),
			ready: false,
			dirty: false,
			blocked: false,
			outcome: 'idle',
			unknownOperationId: undefined,
			resources: idleResources()
		});
		await this.load();
	}
	private async confirm(
		reason: 'reload' | 'switch' | 'leave',
		host = this.props.host,
		next?: EditorPageTarget
	): Promise<boolean> {
		if (!this.state.dirty && !this.unknown) return true;
		if (!host.confirmDiscard) {
			this.publish(
				{ error: '未保存内容或未知操作仍在；宿主未允许丢弃，已阻止此操作' },
				{ key: 'app.templates.editors.unsavedContentOrAnUnknownOperationRemainsTheHost' }
			);
			return false;
		}
		const { controller, current } = this.begin('confirm');
		if (!current()) return false;
		try {
			const allowed = await host.confirmDiscard({
				reason,
				current: documentCopy(this.state.target, this.state.value),
				next: next && targetCopy(next),
				unknownOperationId: this.unknown?.operationId,
				signal: controller.signal
			});
			if (!current()) return false;
			this.publish(
				{
					pending: null,
					error: allowed === true ? '' : '已保留未保存内容，操作被阻止'
				},
				allowed === true
					? undefined
					: { key: 'app.templates.editors.unsavedContentIsRetainedTheActionIsBlocked' }
			);
			return allowed === true;
		} catch (error) {
			if (current())
				this.publish(
					{
						pending: null,
						error: this.message(error, '丢弃确认失败，内容保留')
					},
					{
						key: 'app.templates.editors.discardConfirmationFailedContentIsRetained',
						cause: error
					}
				);
			return false;
		}
	}
	private message(error: unknown, fallback: string) {
		return error instanceof Error ? `${fallback}：${error.message}` : fallback;
	}
	async load(): Promise<void> {
		if (this.dead || this.props.active === false || this.state.pending || this.state.blocked)
			return;
		const { controller, current } = this.begin('load');
		if (!current()) return;
		const target = targetCopy(this.state.target);
		try {
			const result = await this.props.host.load({
				target: targetCopy(target),
				signal: controller.signal
			});
			if (!current()) return;
			if (!result || !sameEditorPageTarget(result, target))
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					new Error('加载回包身份或版本不匹配'),
					'app.templates.editors.theLoadedResponseHasADifferentIdentityOrRevision'
				);
			if (result.value === undefined)
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					new Error('加载回包缺少原生正文值'),
					'app.templates.editors.theLoadedResponseIsMissingTheNativeContentValue'
				);
			const value = documentCopy(target, result.value).value;
			this.baseline = JSON.stringify(value);
			this.publish({
				value,
				ready: true,
				dirty: false,
				pending: null,
				error: '',
				outcome: 'idle'
			});
		} catch (error) {
			if (current())
				this.publish(
					{
						pending: null,
						error: this.message(error, '加载失败，已有内容保留')
					},
					{
						key: 'app.templates.editors.loadingFailedExistingContentIsRetained',
						cause: error
					}
				);
		}
	}
	async reload(): Promise<void> {
		if (
			this.dead ||
			this.props.disabled ||
			this.props.active === false ||
			this.state.pending ||
			this.state.blocked
		)
			return;
		if (!(await this.confirm('reload'))) return;
		this.invalidate();
		this.unknown = undefined;
		this.publish({ unknownOperationId: undefined, outcome: 'idle' });
		await this.load();
	}
	update(value: EditorPageValue): void {
		if (
			!this.writable() ||
			!this.state.ready ||
			this.state.blocked ||
			['load', 'confirm'].includes(this.state.pending ?? '')
		)
			return;
		const copy = documentCopy(this.state.target, value).value;
		this.publish({ value: copy, dirty: JSON.stringify(copy) !== this.baseline });
	}
	resourceState(resources: EditorPageState['resources']): void {
		if (!this.dead) this.publish({ resources: { ...resources } });
	}
	async save(): Promise<void> {
		if (
			!this.writable() ||
			!this.state.ready ||
			this.state.pending ||
			this.state.blocked ||
			this.unknown
		)
			return;
		const resource = this.state.resources;
		if (resource.pending || resource.error || resource.status === 'cancelled') {
			this.publish(
				{ error: '请先处理资源上传、错误或取消状态' },
				{
					key: 'app.templates.editors.resolvePendingUploadsResourceErrorsOrCancellationBeforeSaving'
				}
			);
			return;
		}
		if (
			this.props.maxLength !== undefined &&
			editorValueLength(this.state.value) > this.props.maxLength
		) {
			this.publish(
				{ error: '内容超过长度限制，原内容保留' },
				{ key: 'app.templates.editors.contentExceedsTheLengthLimitTheOriginalContentIs' }
			);
			return;
		}
		const request = documentCopy(this.state.target, this.state.value);
		const operationId = `${this.instanceId}:${++this.sequence}`;
		const host = this.props.host;
		const { controller, current } = this.begin('save');
		if (!current()) return;
		this.unknown = { request: documentCopy(request, request.value), operationId, host };
		try {
			const result = await host.save({
				...request,
				operationId,
				signal: controller.signal
			} as EditorPageWrite);
			if (current()) this.accept(result);
		} catch (error) {
			if (current()) {
				this.publish({ pending: null });
				this.rememberUnknown();
				this.publish(
					{ error: this.message(error, '传输失败，保存结果未知，内容保留') },
					{
						key: 'app.templates.editors.transferFailedTheSaveResultIsUnknownAndContent',
						cause: error
					}
				);
			}
		}
	}
	private accept(result: EditorPageWriteResult) {
		const job = this.unknown;
		if (!job) return;
		const epoch = this.epoch;
		if (
			!result ||
			!result.target ||
			!sameEditorPageTarget(result.target, job.request) ||
			result.operationId !== job.operationId ||
			!['saved', 'not-written', 'unknown'].includes(result.status) ||
			(result.status === 'saved' && !validId(result.revision))
		) {
			this.publish({ pending: null });
			this.rememberUnknown();
			this.publish(
				{ error: '保存/核实回包无效或身份不匹配，结果未知，内容保留' },
				{ key: 'app.templates.editors.theSaveOrVerificationResponseIsInvalidOrHas' }
			);
			return;
		}
		if (result.status === 'unknown') {
			this.publish({ pending: null });
			this.rememberUnknown();
			return;
		}
		this.unknown = undefined;
		if (result.status === 'not-written') {
			this.publish(
				{
					pending: null,
					outcome: 'not-written',
					unknownOperationId: undefined,
					error:
						typeof result.message === 'string'
							? result.message
							: '明确未写入，内容保留，可显式重试'
				},
				typeof result.message === 'string'
					? undefined
					: {
							key: 'app.templates.editors.theWriteWasConfirmedNotAppliedContentIsRetained'
						}
			);
			return;
		}
		this.baseline = JSON.stringify(job.request.value);
		const target = { ...this.state.target, revision: result.revision };
		this.publish({
			target,
			pending: null,
			outcome: 'saved',
			unknownOperationId: undefined,
			error: '',
			dirty: JSON.stringify(this.state.value) !== this.baseline
		});
		if (!this.dead && epoch === this.epoch) this.saved(documentCopy(target, job.request.value));
	}
	async verify(): Promise<void> {
		const job = this.unknown;
		if (!job || !this.writable() || this.state.pending || this.state.blocked) return;
		if (!job.host.verify) {
			this.publish(
				{ error: '宿主未提供核实服务，原操作仍未核实；请保留内容并联系宿主对账' },
				{
					key: 'app.templates.editors.theHostDidNotProvideVerificationTheOriginalOperation'
				}
			);
			return;
		}
		const { controller, current } = this.begin('verify');
		if (!current()) return;
		try {
			const result = await job.host.verify({
				target: targetCopy(job.request),
				operationId: job.operationId,
				signal: controller.signal
			});
			if (current()) this.accept(result);
		} catch (error) {
			if (current())
				this.publish(
					{
						pending: null,
						error: this.message(error, '核实失败，原操作仍未核实'),
						outcome: 'unknown'
					},
					{
						key: 'app.templates.editors.verificationFailedTheOriginalOperationRemainsUnverified',
						cause: error
					}
				);
		}
	}
	cancel(): void {
		this.configuration++;
		this.invalidate();
	}
	async requestLeave(): Promise<boolean> {
		if (this.state.pending) this.invalidate();
		return this.confirm('leave');
	}
	dispose(): void {
		this.dead = true;
		this.invalidate();
	}
}
css
.asam-editor-page {
	box-sizing: border-box;
	width: 100%;
	max-width: 76rem;
	min-width: 0;
	margin: auto;
	padding: var(--asam-space-lg, 24px);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	font-family: var(--el-font-family);
	line-height: 1.65;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	--editor-page-control-height: 32px;
}
.asam-editor-page[data-size='small'] {
	--editor-page-control-height: 28px;
}
.asam-editor-page[data-size='big'] {
	--editor-page-control-height: 36px;
}
.asam-editor-page[data-size='large'] {
	--editor-page-control-height: 40px;
}
.asam-editor-page header,
.asam-editor-page nav,
.asam-editor-page footer {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}
.asam-editor-page h1 {
	margin: 0;
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xl, 24px);
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-eyebrow {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
	margin: 0;
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-body {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 13rem;
	gap: var(--asam-space-lg, 24px);
	margin-block: var(--asam-space-lg, 24px);
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-content {
	min-width: 0;
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-notes {
	border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	padding-inline-start: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-notes h2 {
	font-size: inherit;
	margin-block-start: 0;
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-feedback {
	min-height: 2em;
	padding-block: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}
.asam-editor-page [role='alert'] {
	color: var(--el-color-danger);
}
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='markdown'] button:not([class*='el-']) {
	box-sizing: border-box;
	min-height: var(--editor-page-control-height);
	max-width: 100%;
	padding-inline: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control);
	color: inherit;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	font: inherit;
	cursor: pointer;
}
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='markdown'] button:not([class*='el-'])[data-primary] {
	background: var(--asam-color-primary);
	color: var(--el-color-white);
	border-color: var(--asam-color-primary);
}
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='markdown'] .editor-page-actions button:not([class*='el-']),
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='markdown'] .editor-page-feedback > button:not([class*='el-']) {
	height: auto;
	min-width: 0;
	white-space: normal;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	padding-block: var(--asam-space-xs, 4px);
	line-height: 1.2;
}
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='markdown'] button:not([class*='el-']):disabled {
	opacity: 0.6;
	cursor: not-allowed;
}
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='markdown'] button:not([class*='el-']):focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--asam-color-primary);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.asam-editor-page .asam-markdown-source {
	min-height: 26rem;
	font-family: var(--el-font-family-monospace, monospace);
}
.asam-editor-page .asam-editor-content {
	min-height: 26rem;
}
.asam-editor-page img {
	max-width: 100%;
	height: auto;
}
.asam-editor-page pre {
	max-width: 100%;
	overflow: auto;
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-format {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
	.asam-editor-page {
		padding: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	}
	.asam-editor-page .editor-page-body {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.asam-editor-page .editor-page-notes {
		border-inline-start: 0;
		border-block-start: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
		padding: var(--asam-space-md, 16px) 0 0;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.asam-editor-page *,
	.asam-editor-page *::before,
	.asam-editor-page *::after {
		scroll-behavior: auto;
		transition: none;
		animation: none;
	}
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] {
	container: richtext-page / inline-size;
	max-width: none;
	min-block-size: 100vh;
	padding: 0 0 var(--asam-space-xl);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-muted);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-header {
	gap: var(--asam-space-lg);
	padding: var(--asam-space-lg) clamp(1rem, 4%, 3.5rem);
	border-block-end: 1px solid var(--asam-color-divider);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
}

.editor-page-heading {
	display: flex;
	min-inline-size: 0;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}

.editor-page-document-icon {
	display: grid;
	flex: none;
	inline-size: 2.625rem;

	place-items: center;
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card);

}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-heading h1 {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-lg);
	line-height: 1.35;
}

.editor-page-document-name {
	margin: var(--asam-space-xs) 0 0;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xs);
	line-height: 1.35;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-actions {
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-xs);
}

.asam-editor-page:where([data-kind='richtext']) .editor-page-actions .asam-button {
	margin-inline-start: 0;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-action.asam-button {
	min-block-size: var(--editor-page-control-height);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-action.asam-button:disabled {
	color: var(--el-button-disabled-text-color);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext']
	.editor-page-action.asam-button:not(:disabled):is(:hover, :focus-visible) {
	background-color: var(--asam-color-surface-soft);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
}

.editor-page-more.asam-button {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xl);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-save.asam-button:disabled {
	border-color: var(--asam-color-surface-soft);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-soft);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}

.editor-page-save-status,
.editor-page-footer {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xs);
}

.editor-page-save-status {
	margin-inline-end: var(--asam-space-sm);
}

.editor-page-save-status::before {
	display: inline-block;
	inline-size: 0.45rem;
	block-size: 0.45rem;
	margin-inline-end: var(--asam-space-xs);
	border-radius: 50%;
	background: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
	vertical-align: middle;
	content: '';
}

.editor-page-save-status[data-status='ready']::before {
	background: var(--asam-color-success);
}

.editor-page-save-status[data-status='dirty']::before {
	background: var(--asam-color-warning);
}

.editor-page-save-status[data-status='pending']::before {
	background: var(--asam-color-primary);
}

.editor-page-save-status[data-status='error']::before {
	background: var(--asam-color-danger);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-body,
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-feedback {
	width: min(calc(100% - 2rem), 72rem);
	margin-inline: auto;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-body {
	gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5%, 1.75rem);
	margin-block: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.125rem) var(--asam-space-lg);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-content {
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	box-shadow: 0 2px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--asam-color-shadow) 24%, transparent);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor {
	border: 0;
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content .tiptap {

	min-block-size: 35rem;
	padding: clamp(1rem, 5%, 2.625rem) clamp(1rem, 7.5%, 4.375rem);
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-md);
	line-height: 1.8;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content h1 {
	margin: 0 0 0.75rem;

	line-height: 1.3;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content :is(h2, h3) {

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content h2 {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xl);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content h3 {

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content :is(p, ol, ul) {

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content :is(ol, ul) {

}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content li > p {

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content blockquote {

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content blockquote p {

}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-preview-bar,
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-footer,
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-empty {
	padding: var(--asam-space-sm) var(--asam-space-md);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-preview-bar {
	border-block-end: 1px solid var(--asam-color-divider);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-soft);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-footer {
	min-block-size: 2.875rem;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	border-block-start: 1px solid var(--asam-color-divider);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes {
	border: 0;
	padding: 12px 0 0;
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-sm);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes h2 {
	margin: 0 0 var(--asam-space-md);
	font-weight: var(--asam-typography-font-weight-bold);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes dl {
	margin: 0;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes dl > div {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
	margin-block-end: var(--asam-space-xs);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes dt {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes dd {
	margin: 0;
}

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline {
	display: block;
	margin-block-end: var(--asam-space-md);
	padding-block-end: var(--asam-space-xl);
	border-block-end: 1px solid var(--asam-color-divider);
}

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline ul {
	margin: 0;
	padding: 0;
	list-style: none;
}

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline [data-level='2'] .asam-button {
	padding-inline-start: var(--asam-space-lg);
}

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline [data-level='3'] .asam-button {
	padding-inline-start: var(--asam-space-xl);
}

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline .asam-button {
	justify-content: flex-start;
	inline-size: 100%;
	max-inline-size: 100%;
	min-block-size: 2rem;
	padding-block: var(--asam-space-xs);
	padding-inline: var(--asam-space-sm);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline .asam-button:is(:hover, :focus-visible, [aria-current]) {
	background-color: var(--asam-color-surface-soft);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline .asam-button[aria-current] {
	font-weight: var(--asam-typography-font-weight-bold);
}

@container richtext-page (width <= 760px) {
	.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-body {
		width: calc(100% - 1.25rem);
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}

	.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes {
		display: none;
	}

	.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-actions {
		inline-size: 100%;

	.editor-page-save-status {
		margin-inline-end: auto;

	.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content .tiptap {
		min-block-size: 0;
		padding: 1.5rem 1rem 2.5rem;

	.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content h1 {
		font-size: 1.5rem;
	}

export { default as RichTextEditorPage } from './RichTextEditorPage.vue';
export { default as MarkdownEditorPage } from './MarkdownEditorPage.vue';
export type * from './Types.js';

<!-- eslint-disable vue/html-indent -- Template layout follows the repository Prettier configuration. -->
<template>
	<section
		v-if="active !== false"
		class="asam-editor-page"
		:data-size="size ?? 'default'"

			><AsamButton

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDialog, AsamDropdown, AsamDropdownItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamEditorNode } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamContentEditor } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
import { useEditorPage } from './UseEditorPage.js';
import type { EditorPageEmits, EditorPageExpose, RichTextEditorPageProps } from './Types.js';
import './EditorPages.css';

defineOptions({ name: 'RichTextEditorPage', inheritAttrs: false });
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<RichTextEditorPageProps>(), {
	active: true,
	readonly: false,
	disabled: false,
	size: 'default'
});
const emit = defineEmits<EditorPageEmits>();
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
const {
	editor,
	state,
	displayError,
	model,
	preview,
	composing,
	session,
	length,
	locked,
	canSave,
	resourceState,
	shortcut,
	api
} = useEditorPage(
	props,
	'richtext',
	(value) => emit('state', value),
	(value) => emit('saved', value)
);
const previewAttributes = computed<Pick<HTMLAttributes, 'aria-pressed'>>(() => ({
	'aria-pressed': preview.value
}));
const documentActionAttributes = computed<Pick<HTMLAttributes, 'aria-label'>>(() => ({
	'aria-label': i18n.t('app.templates.editors.documentActions')
}));
const content = shallowRef<HTMLElement>();
const confirmClear = shallowRef(false);
const outlineIndex = shallowRef(0);
watch([session, preview], () => {
	confirmClear.value = false;
});
watch(session, () => {
	outlineIndex.value = 0;
});

const usage = computed(() => {
	const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(i18n.locale.value);
	const used = formatter.format(length.value);
	return props.maxLength === undefined ? used : used + ' / ' + formatter.format(props.maxLength);
});

const pendingLabels = computed(() => ({
	load: i18n.t('app.templates.editors.loadingContent'),
	save: i18n.t('app.templates.editors.savingContent'),
	verify: i18n.t('app.templates.editors.verifyingTheOriginalOperation'),
	confirm: i18n.t('app.templates.editors.confirmingUnsavedContent')
}));
const status = computed(() => {
	const { pending, outcome, dirty, ready } = state.value;
	if (pending) return pendingLabels.value[pending];
	if (outcome === 'unknown')
		return i18n.t('app.templates.editors.theSaveResultIsUnknownContentIs');
	if (outcome === 'saved')
		return i18n.t(
			dirty
				? 'app.templates.editors.theLastSubmissionWasSavedLaterChanges'
				: 'app.templates.editors.contentSaved'
		);
	if (dirty) return i18n.t('app.templates.editors.unsavedChanges');
	return i18n.t(
		ready ? 'app.templates.editors.contentLoaded' : 'app.templates.editors.waitingToLoadContent'
	);
});
const statusTone = computed(() => {
	const { pending, outcome, dirty, ready, error } = state.value;
	if (pending) return 'pending';
	if (outcome === 'unknown' || error) return 'error';
	if (dirty) return 'dirty';
	return ready ? 'ready' : 'idle';
});
function textOf(node: AsamEditorNode): string {
	return node.text ?? node.content?.map(textOf).join('') ?? '';
}
const outline = computed(() => {
	if (typeof model.value === 'string') return [];
	return model.value.content
		.filter((node) => node.type === 'heading')
		.map((node) => ({
			level: node.attrs?.level ?? 1,
			text: textOf(node)
		}));
});
const documentName = computed(() => outline.value.find((heading) => heading.text.trim())?.text);
const currentOutlineIndex = computed(() =>
	outline.value[outlineIndex.value] ? outlineIndex.value : 0
);
function scrollToHeading(index: number) {
	outlineIndex.value = index;
	content.value
		?.querySelectorAll('.tiptap > :is(h1, h2, h3)')
		[index]?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
}
function documentAction(command: string | number | object) {
	if (command === 'reload') void api.reload();
	if (command === 'clear' && !locked.value && !preview.value && !composing.value)
		confirmClear.value = true;
}
function clearContent() {
	confirmClear.value = false;
	if (!locked.value && !preview.value && !composing.value && !state.value.pending)
		editor.value?.clear();
}
defineExpose<EditorPageExpose>(api);
</script>
ts
import type { AsamControlSize, AsamEditorDocument } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamEditorFieldState, AsamResourceServices } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';

export type EditorPageKind = 'richtext' | 'markdown';
export type EditorPageId = string | number;
export type EditorPageValue = AsamEditorDocument | string;
export interface EditorPageIdentity {
	readonly identity: string;
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly documentId: EditorPageId;
	readonly revision: EditorPageId;
}
export type EditorPageTarget = EditorPageIdentity & { readonly kind: EditorPageKind };
export type EditorPageDocument =
	| (EditorPageIdentity & { readonly kind: 'richtext'; readonly value: AsamEditorDocument })
	| (EditorPageIdentity & { readonly kind: 'markdown'; readonly value: string });
export interface EditorPageRead {
	readonly target: EditorPageTarget;
	readonly signal: AbortSignal;
}
export type EditorPageWrite = EditorPageDocument & {
	readonly operationId: string;
	readonly signal: AbortSignal;
};
export type EditorPageWriteResult = {
	readonly target: EditorPageTarget;
	readonly operationId: string;
} & (
	| { readonly status: 'saved'; readonly revision: EditorPageId }
	| { readonly status: 'not-written'; readonly message: string }
	| { readonly status: 'unknown'; readonly message: string }
);
export interface EditorPageHost {
	load(input: EditorPageRead): Promise<EditorPageDocument>;
	save(input: EditorPageWrite): Promise<EditorPageWriteResult>;
	verify?(
		input: EditorPageRead & { readonly operationId: string }
	): Promise<EditorPageWriteResult>;
	/** 未提供时阻止丢弃。true 表示宿主已明确取得丢弃许可。 */
	confirmDiscard?(input: {
		readonly reason: 'reload' | 'switch' | 'leave';
		readonly current: EditorPageDocument;
		readonly next?: EditorPageTarget;
		readonly unknownOperationId?: string;
		readonly signal: AbortSignal;
	}): boolean | Promise<boolean>;
}
export interface EditorPageProps {
	readonly target: EditorPageTarget;
	readonly host: EditorPageHost;
	readonly resources?: AsamResourceServices;
	readonly title?: string;
	readonly active?: boolean;
	readonly readonly?: boolean;
	readonly disabled?: boolean;
	readonly size?: AsamControlSize;
	readonly maxLength?: number;
}
export type RichTextEditorPageProps = Omit<EditorPageProps, 'target'> & {
	readonly target: EditorPageTarget & { readonly kind: 'richtext' };
};
export type MarkdownEditorPageProps = Omit<EditorPageProps, 'target'> & {
	readonly target: EditorPageTarget & { readonly kind: 'markdown' };
};
export interface EditorPageState {
	readonly target: EditorPageTarget;
	readonly value: EditorPageValue;
	readonly ready: boolean;
	readonly dirty: boolean;
	readonly pending: 'load' | 'save' | 'verify' | 'confirm' | null;
	readonly outcome: 'idle' | 'saved' | 'not-written' | 'unknown';
	readonly error: string;
	readonly blocked: boolean;
	readonly unknownOperationId?: string;
	readonly resources: AsamEditorFieldState;
}
export interface EditorPageExpose {
	reload(): Promise<void>;
	save(): Promise<void>;
	verify(): Promise<void>;
	cancel(): void;
	requestLeave(): Promise<boolean>;
	getState(): EditorPageState;
	focus(): void;
}
export interface EditorPageEmits {
	state: [state: EditorPageState];
	saved: [document: EditorPageDocument];
}
ts
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { editorValueLength } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamContentEditorExpose } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { EditorPageController, sameEditorPageTarget } from './Controller.js';
import type {
	EditorPageDocument,
	EditorPageKind,
	EditorPageProps,
	EditorPageState
} from './Types.js';

export function useEditorPage(
	props: EditorPageProps,
	kind: EditorPageKind,
	onState: (state: EditorPageState) => void,
	onSaved: (document: EditorPageDocument) => void
) {
	const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
	if (props.target.kind !== kind) throw new TypeError('页面与文档格式不匹配');
	const editor = shallowRef<AsamContentEditorExpose>();
	const state = shallowRef<EditorPageState>();
	const preview = ref(false);
	const composing = ref(false);
	const session = ref(0);
	const controller = new EditorPageController(
		props,
		(value) => {
			state.value = value;
			onState(controller.getState());
		},
		onSaved,
		() => {
			composing.value = false;
			editor.value?.cancel();
		}
	);
	state.value = controller.getState();
	let previousHost = props.host;
	let previousResources = props.resources;
	let previousFlags = [props.active, props.disabled, props.readonly];
	watch(
		() => [
			props.target,
			props.host,
			props.resources,
			props.active,
			props.disabled,
			props.readonly,
			props.maxLength
		],
		() => {
			if (props.target.kind !== kind) throw new TypeError('请成对切换页面与原生文档模型');
			const flags = [props.active, props.disabled, props.readonly];
			if (
				!sameEditorPageTarget(props.target, controller.getState().target) ||
				previousHost !== props.host ||
				previousResources !== props.resources ||
				flags.some((value, index) => value !== previousFlags[index])
			)
				session.value++;
			previousHost = props.host;
			previousResources = props.resources;
			previousFlags = flags;
			void controller.configure(props);
		},
		{ deep: true, flush: 'pre' }
	);
	const model = computed({
		get: () => state.value!.value,
		set: (value) => controller.update(value)
	});
	const length = computed(() => editorValueLength(model.value));
	const locked = computed(
		() =>
			props.disabled ||
			props.readonly ||
			props.active === false ||
			state.value!.blocked ||
			!state.value!.ready ||
			['load', 'confirm'].includes(state.value!.pending ?? '')
	);
	const canSave = computed(
		() =>
			!locked.value &&
			!composing.value &&
			!state.value!.pending &&
			!state.value!.unknownOperationId &&
			!state.value!.resources.pending &&
			!state.value!.resources.error &&
			state.value!.resources.status !== 'cancelled' &&
			(props.maxLength === undefined || length.value <= props.maxLength)
	);
	const resourceState = computed(() => {
		const token = session.value;
		return (value: EditorPageState['resources']) => {
			if (token === session.value) controller.resourceState(value);
		};
	});
	const save = async () => {
		if (composing.value) return;
		await controller.save();
	};
	function shortcut(event: KeyboardEvent, allowSave = true) {
		if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 's') {
			event.preventDefault();
			if (!event.repeat && !event.isComposing && allowSave && canSave.value) void save();
		}
	}
	function beforeUnload(event: BeforeUnloadEvent) {
		if (
			state.value!.dirty ||
			state.value!.unknownOperationId ||
			state.value!.pending === 'save'
		) {
			event.preventDefault();
			event.returnValue = '';
		}
	}
	onMounted(() => {
		window.addEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnload);
		void controller.load();
	});
	onBeforeUnmount(() => {
		window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnload);
		controller.dispose();
	});
	const api = {
		reload: () => controller.reload(),
		save,
		verify: () => controller.verify(),
		cancel: () => controller.cancel(),
		requestLeave: () => controller.requestLeave(),
		getState: () => controller.getState(),
		focus: () => {
			if (!locked.value && !preview.value) editor.value?.focus();
		}
	};
	return {
		editor,
		state: computed(() => state.value!),
		displayError: computed(() => {
			void state.value;
			return controller.formatMessage(i18n);
		}),
		model,
		preview,
		composing,
		session,
		length,
		locked,
		canSave,
		resourceState,
		shortcut,
		api
	};
}

import { cloneAsamEditorValue } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamEditorDocument, AsamEditorNode } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamResourceServices } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	EditorPageDocument,
	EditorPageHost,
	EditorPageTarget,
	EditorPageWriteResult
} from '../../../templates/editors/Types.js';

export type FixtureMode = 'success' | 'not-written' | 'unknown' | 'throw' | 'late';
export const sampleText =
	'编辑工作页保留原始正文与明确保存结果。每次编辑都有独立身份与版本，加载失败不会覆盖本地修改，未知结果由宿主沿原操作核实。图像只保留稳定地址，页面预览复用公开安全路径。空白、中文、标点和未知语法均按原文保存。';
export function sampleValue(kind: 'richtext', imageUrl?: string): AsamEditorDocument;
export function sampleValue(kind: 'markdown', imageUrl?: string): string;
export function sampleValue(
	kind: 'richtext' | 'markdown',
	imageUrl = '/fixture.svg'
): AsamEditorDocument | string {
	if (kind === 'markdown')
		return (
			'# 编辑说明\n\n' +
			Array.from(
				{ length: 22 },
				(_, index) => `第 ${index + 1} 段：${sampleText.repeat(2)}`
			).join('\n\n') +
			`\n\n- 原文保存\n- 明确反馈\n\n[文档链接](https://example.com)\n\n![本地图像](${imageUrl})\n\n:::unknown\n<script>原文不执行</script>\n`
		);
	const paragraphs: AsamEditorNode[] = Array.from({ length: 22 }, (_, index) => ({
		type: 'paragraph',
		content: [{ type: 'text', text: `第 ${index + 1} 段：${sampleText.repeat(2)}` }]
	}));
	return {
		type: 'doc',
		content: [
			{
				type: 'heading',
				attrs: { level: 1 },
				content: [{ type: 'text', text: '富文本编辑说明' }]
			},
			...paragraphs,
			{
				type: 'bulletList',
				content: [
					{
						type: 'listItem',
						content: [
							{

				documentId: input.documentId,
				kind: input.kind,
				revision: input.revision
			};

					operationId: input.operationId,
					status: 'not-written',

			if (previous && previous.revision !== input.revision)

					target,
					operationId: input.operationId,
					status: 'not-written',

				operationId: input.operationId,
				status: 'saved',
				revision
			};
			operations.set(input.operationId, saved);
			return mode === 'unknown'
				? {
						target,
						operationId: input.operationId,
						status: 'unknown',
						message: '合成服务已受理，响应未知'

				: saved;
		},
		async verify({ target, operationId, signal }) {
			calls.push({ method: 'verify', target: { ...target }, operationId });
			await wait(signal);
			return (
				operations.get(operationId) ?? {
					target: { ...target },
					operationId,
					status: 'unknown',

			);
		},

		async upload({ file, signal, progress }) {
			const fail = controls.uploadFail;
			await wait(signal, controls.uploadLate);
			progress(60);
			if (fail) throw new Error('合成资源上传失败');
			progress(100);
			return {
				id: 0,
				name: file.name,
				url: imageUrl ?? new URL('/fixture.svg', location.origin).href,
				size: file.size,
				mimeType: file.type
			};
		}
	};
	return {
		host,
		resources,
		controls,
		calls,
		initialDocumentId: website ? 'PRJ-2026-018' : 0,
		initialRevision: website ? 3 : 0,
		snapshot: () => Array.from(records.values(), copy)
	};
}

		this.publish({ blocked: true });
		if (
			!(await this.confirm('switch', oldHost, props.target)) ||
			configuration !== this.configuration ||
			this.dead
		)
			return;
		this.acceptedProps = this.props;
		this.unknown = undefined;
		this.baseline = '';
		this.publish({
			target: targetCopy(props.target),
			value: cloneAsamEditorValue(props.target.kind, undefined),
			ready: false,
			dirty: false,
			blocked: false,
			outcome: 'idle',
			unknownOperationId: undefined,
			resources: idleResources()
		});
		await this.load();
	}
	async confirm(reason, host = this.props.host, next) {
		if (!this.state.dirty && !this.unknown) return true;
		if (!host.confirmDiscard) {
			this.publish(
				{ error: '未保存内容或未知操作仍在；宿主未允许丢弃，已阻止此操作' },
				{ key: 'app.templates.editors.unsavedContentOrAnUnknownOperationRemainsTheHost' }
			);
			return false;
		}
		const { controller, current } = this.begin('confirm');
		if (!current()) return false;
		try {
			const allowed = await host.confirmDiscard({
				reason,
				current: documentCopy(this.state.target, this.state.value),
				next: next && targetCopy(next),
				unknownOperationId: this.unknown?.operationId,
				signal: controller.signal
			});
			if (!current()) return false;
			this.publish(
				{
					pending: null,
					error: allowed === true ? '' : '已保留未保存内容，操作被阻止'
				},
				allowed === true
					? undefined
					: { key: 'app.templates.editors.unsavedContentIsRetainedTheActionIsBlocked' }
			);
			return allowed === true;
		} catch (error) {
			if (current())
				this.publish(
					{
						pending: null,
						error: this.message(error, '丢弃确认失败，内容保留')
					},
					{
						key: 'app.templates.editors.discardConfirmationFailedContentIsRetained',
						cause: error
					}
				);
			return false;
		}
	}
	message(error, fallback) {
		return error instanceof Error ? `${fallback}：${error.message}` : fallback;
	}
	async load() {
		if (this.dead || this.props.active === false || this.state.pending || this.state.blocked)
			return;
		const { controller, current } = this.begin('load');
		if (!current()) return;
		const target = targetCopy(this.state.target);
		try {
			const result = await this.props.host.load({
				target: targetCopy(target),
				signal: controller.signal
			});
			if (!current()) return;
			if (!result || !sameEditorPageTarget(result, target))
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					new Error('加载回包身份或版本不匹配'),
					'app.templates.editors.theLoadedResponseHasADifferentIdentityOrRevision'
				);
			if (result.value === undefined)
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					new Error('加载回包缺少原生正文值'),
					'app.templates.editors.theLoadedResponseIsMissingTheNativeContentValue'
				);
			const value = documentCopy(target, result.value).value;
			this.baseline = JSON.stringify(value);
			this.publish({
				value,
				ready: true,
				dirty: false,
				pending: null,
				error: '',
				outcome: 'idle'
			});
		} catch (error) {
			if (current())
				this.publish(
					{
						pending: null,
						error: this.message(error, '加载失败，已有内容保留')
					},
					{
						key: 'app.templates.editors.loadingFailedExistingContentIsRetained',
						cause: error
					}
				);
		}
	}
	async reload() {
		if (
			this.dead ||
			this.props.disabled ||
			this.props.active === false ||
			this.state.pending ||
			this.state.blocked
		)
			return;
		if (!(await this.confirm('reload'))) return;
		this.invalidate();
		this.unknown = undefined;
		this.publish({ unknownOperationId: undefined, outcome: 'idle' });
		await this.load();
	}
	update(value) {
		if (
			!this.writable() ||
			!this.state.ready ||
			this.state.blocked ||
			['load', 'confirm'].includes(this.state.pending ?? '')
		)
			return;
		const copy = documentCopy(this.state.target, value).value;
		this.publish({ value: copy, dirty: JSON.stringify(copy) !== this.baseline });
	}
	resourceState(resources) {
		if (!this.dead) this.publish({ resources: { ...resources } });
	}
	async save() {
		if (
			!this.writable() ||
			!this.state.ready ||
			this.state.pending ||
			this.state.blocked ||
			this.unknown
		)
			return;
		const resource = this.state.resources;
		if (resource.pending || resource.error || resource.status === 'cancelled') {
			this.publish(
				{ error: '请先处理资源上传、错误或取消状态' },
				{
					key: 'app.templates.editors.resolvePendingUploadsResourceErrorsOrCancellationBeforeSaving'
				}
			);
			return;
		}
		if (
			this.props.maxLength !== undefined &&
			editorValueLength(this.state.value) > this.props.maxLength
		) {
			this.publish(
				{ error: '内容超过长度限制，原内容保留' },
				{ key: 'app.templates.editors.contentExceedsTheLengthLimitTheOriginalContentIs' }
			);
			return;
		}
		const request = documentCopy(this.state.target, this.state.value);
		const operationId = `${this.instanceId}:${++this.sequence}`;
		const host = this.props.host;
		const { controller, current } = this.begin('save');
		if (!current()) return;
		this.unknown = { request: documentCopy(request, request.value), operationId, host };
		try {
			const result = await host.save({
				...request,
				operationId,
				signal: controller.signal
			});
			if (current()) this.accept(result);
		} catch (error) {
			if (current()) {
				this.publish({ pending: null });
				this.rememberUnknown();
				this.publish(
					{ error: this.message(error, '传输失败，保存结果未知，内容保留') },
					{
						key: 'app.templates.editors.transferFailedTheSaveResultIsUnknownAndContent',
						cause: error
					}
				);
			}
		}
	}
	accept(result) {
		const job = this.unknown;
		if (!job) return;
		const epoch = this.epoch;
		if (
			!result ||
			!result.target ||
			!sameEditorPageTarget(result.target, job.request) ||
			result.operationId !== job.operationId ||
			!['saved', 'not-written', 'unknown'].includes(result.status) ||
			(result.status === 'saved' && !validId(result.revision))
		) {
			this.publish({ pending: null });
			this.rememberUnknown();
			this.publish(
				{ error: '保存/核实回包无效或身份不匹配，结果未知，内容保留' },
				{ key: 'app.templates.editors.theSaveOrVerificationResponseIsInvalidOrHas' }
			);
			return;
		}
		if (result.status === 'unknown') {
			this.publish({ pending: null });
			this.rememberUnknown();
			return;
		}
		this.unknown = undefined;
		if (result.status === 'not-written') {
			this.publish(
				{
					pending: null,
					outcome: 'not-written',
					unknownOperationId: undefined,
					error:
						typeof result.message === 'string'
							? result.message
							: '明确未写入，内容保留，可显式重试'
				},
				typeof result.message === 'string'
					? undefined
					: {
							key: 'app.templates.editors.theWriteWasConfirmedNotAppliedContentIsRetained'
						}
			);
			return;
		}
		this.baseline = JSON.stringify(job.request.value);
		const target = { ...this.state.target, revision: result.revision };
		this.publish({
			target,
			pending: null,
			outcome: 'saved',
			unknownOperationId: undefined,
			error: '',
			dirty: JSON.stringify(this.state.value) !== this.baseline
		});
		if (!this.dead && epoch === this.epoch) this.saved(documentCopy(target, job.request.value));
	}
	async verify() {
		const job = this.unknown;
		if (!job || !this.writable() || this.state.pending || this.state.blocked) return;
		if (!job.host.verify) {
			this.publish(
				{ error: '宿主未提供核实服务，原操作仍未核实；请保留内容并联系宿主对账' },
				{
					key: 'app.templates.editors.theHostDidNotProvideVerificationTheOriginalOperation'
				}
			);
			return;
		}
		const { controller, current } = this.begin('verify');
		if (!current()) return;
		try {
			const result = await job.host.verify({
				target: targetCopy(job.request),
				operationId: job.operationId,
				signal: controller.signal
			});
			if (current()) this.accept(result);
		} catch (error) {
			if (current())
				this.publish(
					{
						pending: null,
						error: this.message(error, '核实失败，原操作仍未核实'),
						outcome: 'unknown'
					},
					{
						key: 'app.templates.editors.verificationFailedTheOriginalOperationRemainsUnverified',
						cause: error
					}
				);
		}
	}
	cancel() {
		this.configuration++;
		this.invalidate();
	}
	async requestLeave() {
		if (this.state.pending) this.invalidate();
		return this.confirm('leave');
	}
	dispose() {
		this.dead = true;
		this.invalidate();
	}
}
css
.asam-editor-page {
	box-sizing: border-box;
	width: 100%;
	max-width: 76rem;
	min-width: 0;
	margin: auto;
	padding: var(--asam-space-lg, 24px);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	font-family: var(--el-font-family);
	line-height: 1.65;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	--editor-page-control-height: 32px;
}
.asam-editor-page[data-size='small'] {
	--editor-page-control-height: 28px;
}
.asam-editor-page[data-size='big'] {
	--editor-page-control-height: 36px;
}
.asam-editor-page[data-size='large'] {
	--editor-page-control-height: 40px;
}
.asam-editor-page header,
.asam-editor-page nav,
.asam-editor-page footer {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}
.asam-editor-page h1 {
	margin: 0;
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xl, 24px);
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-eyebrow {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
	margin: 0;
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-body {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 13rem;
	gap: var(--asam-space-lg, 24px);
	margin-block: var(--asam-space-lg, 24px);
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-content {
	min-width: 0;
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-notes {
	border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	padding-inline-start: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-notes h2 {
	font-size: inherit;
	margin-block-start: 0;
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-feedback {
	min-height: 2em;
	padding-block: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}
.asam-editor-page [role='alert'] {
	color: var(--el-color-danger);
}
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='markdown'] button:not([class*='el-']) {
	box-sizing: border-box;
	min-height: var(--editor-page-control-height);
	max-width: 100%;
	padding-inline: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control);
	color: inherit;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	font: inherit;
	cursor: pointer;
}
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='markdown'] button:not([class*='el-'])[data-primary] {
	background: var(--asam-color-primary);
	color: var(--el-color-white);
	border-color: var(--asam-color-primary);
}
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='markdown'] .editor-page-actions button:not([class*='el-']),
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='markdown'] .editor-page-feedback > button:not([class*='el-']) {
	height: auto;
	min-width: 0;
	white-space: normal;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	padding-block: var(--asam-space-xs, 4px);
	line-height: 1.2;
}
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='markdown'] button:not([class*='el-']):disabled {
	opacity: 0.6;
	cursor: not-allowed;
}
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='markdown'] button:not([class*='el-']):focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--asam-color-primary);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.asam-editor-page .asam-markdown-source {
	min-height: 26rem;
	font-family: var(--el-font-family-monospace, monospace);
}
.asam-editor-page .asam-editor-content {
	min-height: 26rem;
}
.asam-editor-page img {
	max-width: 100%;
	height: auto;
}
.asam-editor-page pre {
	max-width: 100%;
	overflow: auto;
}
.asam-editor-page .editor-page-format {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
	.asam-editor-page {
		padding: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	}
	.asam-editor-page .editor-page-body {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.asam-editor-page .editor-page-notes {
		border-inline-start: 0;
		border-block-start: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
		padding: var(--asam-space-md, 16px) 0 0;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.asam-editor-page *,
	.asam-editor-page *::before,
	.asam-editor-page *::after {
		scroll-behavior: auto;
		transition: none;
		animation: none;
	}
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] {
	container: richtext-page / inline-size;
	max-width: none;
	min-block-size: 100vh;
	padding: 0 0 var(--asam-space-xl);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-muted);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-header {
	gap: var(--asam-space-lg);
	padding: var(--asam-space-lg) clamp(1rem, 4%, 3.5rem);
	border-block-end: 1px solid var(--asam-color-divider);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
}

.editor-page-heading {
	display: flex;
	min-inline-size: 0;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}

.editor-page-document-icon {
	display: grid;
	flex: none;
	inline-size: 2.625rem;
	block-size: 2.625rem;
	place-items: center;
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-soft);
	color: var(--asam-color-primary);
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xl);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-heading h1 {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-lg);
	line-height: 1.35;
}

.editor-page-document-name {
	margin: var(--asam-space-xs) 0 0;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xs);
	line-height: 1.35;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-actions {
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-xs);
}

.asam-editor-page:where([data-kind='richtext']) .editor-page-actions .asam-button {
	margin-inline-start: 0;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-action.asam-button {
	min-block-size: var(--editor-page-control-height);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-action.asam-button:disabled {
	color: var(--el-button-disabled-text-color);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext']
	.editor-page-action.asam-button:not(:disabled):is(:hover, :focus-visible) {
	background-color: var(--asam-color-surface-soft);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
}

.editor-page-more.asam-button {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xl);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-save.asam-button:disabled {
	border-color: var(--asam-color-surface-soft);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-soft);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}

.editor-page-save-status,
.editor-page-footer {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xs);
}

.editor-page-save-status {
	margin-inline-end: var(--asam-space-sm);
}

.editor-page-save-status::before {
	display: inline-block;
	inline-size: 0.45rem;
	block-size: 0.45rem;
	margin-inline-end: var(--asam-space-xs);
	border-radius: 50%;
	background: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
	vertical-align: middle;
	content: '';
}

.editor-page-save-status[data-status='ready']::before {
	background: var(--asam-color-success);
}

.editor-page-save-status[data-status='dirty']::before {
	background: var(--asam-color-warning);
}

.editor-page-save-status[data-status='pending']::before {
	background: var(--asam-color-primary);
}

.editor-page-save-status[data-status='error']::before {
	background: var(--asam-color-danger);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-body,
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-feedback {
	width: min(calc(100% - 2rem), 72rem);
	margin-inline: auto;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-body {
	gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5%, 1.75rem);
	margin-block: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.125rem) var(--asam-space-lg);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-content {
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	box-shadow: 0 2px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--asam-color-shadow) 24%, transparent);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor {
	border: 0;
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content .tiptap {
	box-sizing: border-box;
	min-block-size: 35rem;
	padding: clamp(1rem, 5%, 2.625rem) clamp(1rem, 7.5%, 4.375rem);
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-md);
	line-height: 1.8;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content h1 {
	margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
	font-size: 2rem;
	line-height: 1.3;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content :is(h2, h3) {
	margin: 1.5rem 0 var(--asam-space-xs);
	line-height: 1.4;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content h2 {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-xl);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content h3 {
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-lg);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content :is(p, ol, ul) {
	margin: 0 0 var(--asam-space-sm);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content :is(ol, ul) {
	padding-inline-start: 1.5rem;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content li > p {
	margin-block-end: var(--asam-space-xs);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content blockquote {
	margin: var(--asam-space-xl) 0;
	padding: 12px var(--asam-space-lg);
	border-inline-start: 3px solid var(--asam-color-primary);
	border-start-end-radius: var(--asam-radius-control);
	border-end-end-radius: var(--asam-radius-control);
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--asam-color-surface-soft) 75%, var(--asam-color-surface));
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content blockquote p {
	margin: 0;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-preview-bar,
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-footer,
.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-empty {
	padding: var(--asam-space-sm) var(--asam-space-md);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-preview-bar {
	border-block-end: 1px solid var(--asam-color-divider);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-soft);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-footer {
	min-block-size: 2.875rem;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	border-block-start: 1px solid var(--asam-color-divider);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes {
	border: 0;
	padding: 12px 0 0;
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-sm);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes h2 {
	margin: 0 0 var(--asam-space-md);
	font-weight: var(--asam-typography-font-weight-bold);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes dl {
	margin: 0;
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes dl > div {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
	margin-block-end: var(--asam-space-xs);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes dt {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
}

.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes dd {
	margin: 0;
}

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline {
	display: block;
	margin-block-end: var(--asam-space-md);
	padding-block-end: var(--asam-space-xl);
	border-block-end: 1px solid var(--asam-color-divider);
}

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline ul {
	margin: 0;
	padding: 0;
	list-style: none;
}

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline [data-level='2'] .asam-button {
	padding-inline-start: var(--asam-space-lg);
}

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline [data-level='3'] .asam-button {
	padding-inline-start: var(--asam-space-xl);
}

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline .asam-button {
	justify-content: flex-start;
	inline-size: 100%;
	max-inline-size: 100%;
	min-block-size: 2rem;
	padding-block: var(--asam-space-xs);
	padding-inline: var(--asam-space-sm);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	white-space: normal;
	text-align: start;
}

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline .asam-button:is(:hover, :focus-visible, [aria-current]) {
	background-color: var(--asam-color-surface-soft);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
}

.asam-editor-page .editor-page-outline .asam-button[aria-current] {
	font-weight: var(--asam-typography-font-weight-bold);
}

@container richtext-page (width <= 760px) {
	.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-body {
		width: calc(100% - 1.25rem);
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}

	.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-notes {
		display: none;
	}

	.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .editor-page-actions {
		inline-size: 100%;
	}

	.editor-page-save-status {
		margin-inline-end: auto;
	}

	.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content .tiptap {
		min-block-size: 0;
		padding: 1.5rem 1rem 2.5rem;
	}

	.asam-editor-page[data-kind='richtext'] .asam-editor-content h1 {
		font-size: 1.5rem;
	}
}

<script setup>
import { computed, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDialog, AsamDropdown, AsamDropdownItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamContentEditor } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
import { useEditorPage } from './UseEditorPage.js';
import './EditorPages.css';
defineOptions({ name: 'RichTextEditorPage', inheritAttrs: false });
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	resources: { type: Object, required: false },
	title: { type: String, required: false },
	active: { type: Boolean, required: false, default: true },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false, default: false },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false, default: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false, default: 'default' },
	maxLength: { type: Number, required: false },
	target: { type: Object, required: true }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['state', 'saved']);
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
const {
	editor,
	state,
	displayError,
	model,
	preview,
	composing,
	session,
	length,
	locked,
	canSave,
	resourceState,
	shortcut,
	api
} = useEditorPage(
	props,
	'richtext',
	(value) => emit('state', value),
	(value) => emit('saved', value)
);
const previewAttributes = computed(() => ({
	'aria-pressed': preview.value
}));
const documentActionAttributes = computed(() => ({
	'aria-label': i18n.t('app.templates.editors.documentActions')
}));
const content = shallowRef();
const confirmClear = shallowRef(false);
const outlineIndex = shallowRef(0);
watch([session, preview], () => {
	confirmClear.value = false;
});
watch(session, () => {
	outlineIndex.value = 0;
});
const usage = computed(() => {
	const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(i18n.locale.value);
	const used = formatter.format(length.value);
	return props.maxLength === undefined ? used : used + ' / ' + formatter.format(props.maxLength);
});
const pendingLabels = computed(() => ({
	load: i18n.t('app.templates.editors.loadingContent'),
	save: i18n.t('app.templates.editors.savingContent'),
	verify: i18n.t('app.templates.editors.verifyingTheOriginalOperation'),
	confirm: i18n.t('app.templates.editors.confirmingUnsavedContent')
}));
const status = computed(() => {
	const { pending, outcome, dirty, ready } = state.value;
	if (pending) return pendingLabels.value[pending];
	if (outcome === 'unknown')
		return i18n.t('app.templates.editors.theSaveResultIsUnknownContentIs');
	if (outcome === 'saved')
		return i18n.t(
			dirty
				? 'app.templates.editors.theLastSubmissionWasSavedLaterChanges'
				: 'app.templates.editors.contentSaved'
		);
	if (dirty) return i18n.t('app.templates.editors.unsavedChanges');

	const { pending, outcome, dirty, ready, error } = state.value;
	if (pending) return 'pending';

function textOf(node) {
	return node.text ?? node.content?.map(textOf).join('') ?? '';
}

	if (typeof model.value === 'string') return [];
	return model.value.content

const currentOutlineIndex = computed(() =>
	outline.value[outlineIndex.value] ? outlineIndex.value : 0

import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { editorValueLength } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { EditorPageController, sameEditorPageTarget } from './Controller.js';
export function useEditorPage(props, kind, onState, onSaved) {
	const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
	if (props.target.kind !== kind) throw new TypeError('页面与文档格式不匹配');
	const editor = shallowRef();
	const state = shallowRef();
	const preview = ref(false);
	const composing = ref(false);
	const session = ref(0);
	const controller = new EditorPageController(
		props,
		(value) => {
			state.value = value;
			onState(controller.getState());
		},
		onSaved,
		() => {
			composing.value = false;
			editor.value?.cancel();
		}
